[attribute-contrib-type]
=== `@contrib-type` Type of Contribution

Type of contribution made by the individual (for example, “`author`”, “`editor`”, “`illustrator`”, “`translator`”, “`research-assistant`”).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-contrib,`<contrib>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Word or phrase naming or describing the contribution, such as
                        “`editor`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
